sources.title: Near-surface circulation in the Tropical Atlantic Ocean
sources.verified_from: Primary-publisher and official NOAA PDF search-index text; direct full-file access failed.
sources.supported_context: Drifter-derived tropical Atlantic circulation is decomposed into a mean component, annual and semiannual terms, plus residual variability. The paper distinguishes total and Ekman-removed velocities.
sources.relevant_followup: Recover the original methods and current-description sections and inspect Figures6 and9 before selecting an Atlantic NEC domain, edges or alongflow gates.

sources.title: North Atlantic surface circulation during the 1990's observed with satellite-tracked drifters
sources.author: David M. Fratantoni
sources.supported_context: A North Atlantic compilation uses over1500 satellite-tracked drifters drogued at nominal15m, from January1990 through December1999, with velocity and eddy-energy fields on a1-degree grid.
sources.exclusion: The abstract maximum drifter speed belongs to the Gulf Stream; it is not an Atlantic NEC speed or dimension.

sources.title: The mean flow field of the tropical Atlantic Ocean
sources.supported_context: The study examines20N–20S circulation in surface, central-water and Antarctic Intermediate Water layers.
sources.exclusion: The study latitude domain is not a current width. Water-mass layer categories are not a uniform NEC thickness.
